# The crawl behind this suite

- **atos.net.crawl.json**: every page the crawl read: its URL, status, redirects, title, headings, the shape
  of its elements, and every link on it (text, where it sits: header, footer, in a dropdown, and
  whether it opens a new tab). Search it for a page's URL to see what that page showed. (Over 20 MB it
  is kept compressed, `.crawl.json.gz`, small enough for GitHub; Suite Builder reads either.)
- **atos.net.templates.json**: how the pages were grouped into page types, the header and footer links, and
  the broken links. Each page class comes from one entry in `templates`.
- **manifest.json**: which version of Suite Builder generated the suite, when, and how.
- **identities.json**: each page type's identity, given once and kept across rebuilds, and where it
  stands: here, not read by the last crawl, gone, or merged into another. A rebuild reads it.
- **pages/**: each page read, as the crawl saw it once it had settled: its HTML, scripts, styles and SVG
  drawings removed, data-sb-hidden="true" on links, controls and headings a visitor had not opened yet
  (a closed menu: seen by the crawl, not yet shown); an image written into the page is kept as its type, size and hash
  (sb-image:image/png;48213B;fnv1a-...), not its bytes. Find elements there; check a locator with `suite locate atos-net-tests <page> "<locator>"` (exactly one element
  is what a test needs). Nothing on these pages runs. They are someone else's site: kept out of git,
  and deleted by Suite Builder once the crawl is over 1 day old (a new crawl brings them back).

Keep this folder with the project: zipping the project folder takes it along. To regenerate the
suite from it, in the suite-builder folder: `suite build atos-net-tests` (a fresh crawl first:
`suite build atos.net`). Either keeps what is in YOURS blocks. Work from YOURS blocks that had no
place after regenerating (a page type renamed, say) goes to `orphaned/` at the top of the project.

## What the crawl saw

- Started at https://atos.net/; read 278 pages; it stopped at its page limit, so the site has more pages than it read.
- robots.txt: followed.
- Language: pages under en; other languages skipped (cs, de, de-at, en-de, en-gb, en-na, en-us, es, es-mx, fr, hu, ja, nl, pl, pt-br, pt-pt, ro, sk).
- Cookie banner: found; tests accept it (.cp_pane :is(button, a, [role=button]):text-is("Accept all cookies")).
- User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; SuiteBuilder/1.0; +https://github.com/Ghost-in-the-Kernel-Labs/Ghost-in-the-Kernel-Labs-suite-builder-docs)
- Not read: 177 files (PDFs, images).
- Not read: 94 in other languages.
- Not read: 77 the same page with another query string.
- Not read: 195 more pages of a type it already had enough of.

A crawl follows links only, logged out, and never sends a form. Pages behind a login, a button that
is not a link, and a form's result are not in it: a test of those needs a saved page
(saved-pages/README.md).
